player_prompt.intro:
I ni Player {player_id} ka kalan ka Checkers ɔɔrɔn {color}.
Kɛɛ fɛɛ kɔɔnɛ kɛɛ chess-style notation [fileRank fileRank], nɔɔ bɛɛɛ '[b2c3]' (kɔlɔnɛ a–h, sɛri digit 0–7).
Kalan kɔɔrɔ:
  • Kɛɛ daɲɛ ka ɲɔɔnɛ kɔɔnɛ ɲɔɔnɛ fɛɛ.
  • Kɛɛ bɔɔɲɛ kɛɛ fɔɔɲɛ dɔɔɲɛ kɔɔnɛ.
  • Kɛɛ kɔɔnɛ kɛɛ ka fɛɛ dɔɔɲɛ kɔɔnɛ ka kɔɔrɔnɛ.

invalid_move.wrong_format: A be se ka ca a la, ka [a1b2], oyo [b2c3].

outcome.red_no_pieces: Funteni tɛ yen bilenman bolo. Nɛgɛtigɛlanw bɛ se!
outcome.black_no_pieces: Funteni tɛ yen bilen na. Kɔrɛnin bɛ se sɔrɔ!
outcome.draw: A yɛlɛma dan ye se ka kɛ.
